comment: Worst professor ever. No grade posted at all throughout the semester and not accessible out of class. No conclusion can be made at the end of discussion. Taking her class is a waste of time!

Jane is such a queen. She is really good at leading discussion and making the classroom feel like a comfortable place to talk about such sensitive topics. I took this class as my english gen-ed and I would highly recommend. I am very STEM oriented and usually hate reading based classes. But I always did the readings they were so crazy interesting.

Definitely take Jane! She's so kind and knowledgable. She is supportive anytime. The workload is very small and the class environment is chill. Only 1 final paper is seriously graded. As you read the materials before going to the classes, you will be fine.
Dr. Geaney is a very understandng lady. If you want to try in a hard way, she definitely would help you. She is also very kind, ask her questions as if you want!

Geaney is amazing! Readings for almost every class, but they vary in length and are essential for class discussions. Not many assignments; the ones you do have you submit, get feedback on, resubmit for grade. She makes class convos actually interesting and engaging. Dr. Geaney is sweet, knowledgable, and doesn't make it impossible to do well.
Definitely recommended!

Prof Geaney is a sweet lady and an extremely knowledgeable/fair teacher... however she uses class time to espouse her own political/social beliefs, often getting far sidetracked from the material at hand. I felt that the environment inspired in her classroom (and her responses to written work) discouraged active challenge/discusssion.

Jane, as she prefers to be called, is very condescending towards students who express confusion with the material. Often if you disagreed in a group discussion with her own opinions, she would cut you off or 'correct' you. She is also a very tough grader on the few papers we did have, which already had very confusing prompts.
Jane definitely wants to help students succeed unlike many other professors at Richmond. I learned a lot when she lectured and I was glad to have Jane even though the readings were tough for me

She can be very condescending which is discouraging and makes students not want to reach out. Also even if you participate to the best of your ability by doing the readings and contributing to discussion often, its not going to be good enough so good luck. Discussions were interesting but overall not worth it.

I am usually wary of classes with heavy participation but Jane creates a space where you feel comfortable enough to voice your thoughts on the interesting things you read and they lead to discussions about things you'd never think about on your own. If you engage in the class, you will be happy with your grade. Must be okay with personal sharing.

readings can be tough but are interesting. Class itself is laid back and fun but make sure you contribute a lot in class conversation. Jane is very nice and open about pretty much everything. very nice when it comes to extensions and incompletes. she let me turn in two papers after the semester had ended when I was sick and was super nice about it.
Enjoyable class with interesting reading material. Class discussions are interesting and the readings are manageable but the essay topics are vague and sometimes confusing. Essays are graded harshly.

Jane is very knowledgeable and has a good grasp on her material. She's open to hearing anything that someone has to say and can respond accordingly to guide the students in the right direction. Overall, she isn't the easiest of graders and she has a tough scale, but getting a good grade is very attainable if you put in effort and follow directions

Jane is very fun to talk to! She is open-minded and wants everyone to engage in her class. There is reading but it is all very interesting. She's fun, and this is one of the classes that I do enjoy going to because of the discussions we get in to. This is not a hard course, but you need to do the readings, and I promise you that it will pay off.

I would recommend Dr Geaney to anyone looking to fill their literature requirement, as well as someone who's interested in gender and sexuality studies. She engages with the class in thoughtful dialogues that cover a wide array of unique concepts that you won't find in any other class in Richmond. She's very thoughtful, respectful, and kindhearted

I was worried about taking Dr. Geaney for class because of the comments I read here,however, after taking her FYS I am truly surprised about my experience. The class isn't easy, but it isn't hard. It requires effort, but it isn't unreasonable. She is REALLY helpful outside of class if you show that you care.

Lots of reading, but great discussions in class. She makes her grading style crystal clear and if you pay attention to that and follow her guidelines getting an A is super easy, even if you don't really know what you're talking about.
Very knowledgeable but very difficult grader. Expected a certain style of writing for the essays. Kind but presented many of her opinions as fact.

Jane has good intentions but does not seem to be able to execute them well. The class had great potential but she never seemed to be able to come to a clear conclusion about anything. She is quite opinionated and stubborn. Her papers are vague and lack purpose. The actual class time does nothing to prepare you for the assignments. She is unhelpful.

She is very nice. Very strict about writing guidelines. Class is circular and we never seem to come to an agreement. Readings were interesting but in discussion students were often narrow minded, because of personal beliefs. Recommended for anyone who likes to read and write and is not easily offended on religious subjects.

Jane is an amazing professor who is highly receptive of others opinions. I loved her class mainly because it was discussion-based. She is a fair grader and highly personable. Take her courses! She is such a wealth of knowledge and always has an interesting opinion. Her sense of humor is pretty good as well! :D

Jane is unique at Richmond for her tremendous grasp of a traditionally ignored subject -- queer theory. She fosters enriching discussion and never failed to make herself available to further discuss material outside of class. I count her as an incredible mentor and resource on this campus.

I loved the class Queers in Religion. Jane was an enthusiastic professor and I gained so much perspective from this class. Jane is considerate of students, works hard to plan meaningful classes, and willingly stayed after class nearly every day to continue a conversation on the subject or assist students individually. Challenging but enjoyable!

I loved this class and Jane.  I found the use of movies, book and real life experiences to be mind opening. She was always open to meeting after class or working around any personal issue. Her papers are intense but worth it because I now feel better prepared for all my classes. TAKE THIS CLASS!

Geaney tried to give off the impression of being open minded, but when students brought up ideas not consistent with her personal beliefs she shut them down. She came off as immature and fished too hard for injustice towards gays, where there simply was none. I don't recommend this class. I loved the subject matter but, frankly, Geaney ruined it.
was an awesome professor. she was very helpful. graded fairly. even if you didn't understand the material but tried to interpret it in some way that showed you read it she would give you an A.
I enjoyed the conversations we had after reading the texts.  However, I was always unsure of what was expected of me for assignments.  Her grading was not very consistent.
Excellent!
The best teacher I had at UR.  While she expects a lot from her students, if you're willing to put in the work, you'll find her classes to be truly rewarding.
No Comments

A terrible teacher and horrid human being. Should not be in a classroom. She literally hates her students, and hates being at Richmond. If you have an opinion, you might as well leave it at the door. She is one of the main reasons students will not take religion courses. She is a perfect example of why professors should not be tenured.
Really cool lady, takes attendance and has started giving reading quizzes, but she is alot of fun in discussion. Great Teacher.

Jane is wonderfully nice and has a great sense of humor, but her course material was confused and very difficult to comprehend. This class takes tough texts that you don't understand and makes you write papers using tough (seemingly unrelated) literary theories that you also don't understand. For Asia, feminism, and sexuality, Jane's your prof.

You will only like Prof.Geaney if you are smart and willing to actually learn something.Her critiques are very helpful and never condescending.She is a down to earth,humble person with one of the friendliest dogs Ive ever seen.Although she wont reveal her age,she looks like a very beautiful 30-35.
Who calls their professor by his/her first name? Hmmmmm. . .  Suspicious entry below, Prof. Geany.

Jane is awesome!  Her class was hard and I truly thought I wouldn't make it out of their alive at times... but she helps you out when you need it.  Plus, she's beautiful.  I definitely had a crush on her for the majority of my collegiate life.

She is an incredibly hard grader, she shoots down everyone's comments, and she told us to our faces that she wishes she worked at a "better" school like UVA.  Great thing to hear as a new freshman in college.  She sucks.

HORRIBLE Teacher.  She sits and talks about how everyone is not smart enough to understand material. I had her for CORE and she hated everyone and practically failed everyone as well.  She tortures her poor dog as well by dragging it to class.
Very hard grader, very opinionated, brings her**** dog to class
Teacher is very opinionated and unwilling to listen to student comments.
honest, real, straight-forward.
No Comments
No Comments

The classic genius wasting away in the academic wasteland that is UR.  Does not tolerate inarticulate positions contrary to her own.  Will attack if provoked in that fashion.  Has 'mystique' up the wazoo.  Is attractive if you like glasses and pasty skin.
